title: 08. A Train Beneath the Ground
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Whir, whir! A loud rumble comes from beneath their feet. Hori's ears perk up, and he taps the ground. What's that sound underground? It sounds like something is moving! Whir, whir! Traveling beneath the ground!
Mom, trains travel outside. Why does this one run underground? Mom smiles. It's called the subway because it travels below the ground. We can meet it down the stairs. Shall we go with Bori and Kongi?

They walk down the stairs into a bright, wide space. People wait in lines behind a yellow line. This is the platform, where people get on and off the subway. Hori looks around, his heart going thump, thump!

A colorful picture hangs on the wall, with winding red, blue, and green lines. This is the route map. Follow the colored lines to find your station. Kongi tilts their head. Wow! It looks like a colorful candy map!

Tall glass doors stand along the platform. These are platform screen doors. They stay closed until the train arrives, helping keep people away from the tracks. Bori gently touches the glass. They're strong! They help keep us safe.

A train is arriving! says the announcement. Two lights shine at the far end of the dark tunnel. Whir! The subway rushes in with a gust of wind. Through the front window, the driver waves to Hori. Whir, whir! Traveling beneath the ground!

The platform doors and train doors open together. Shall we get on? Hori climbs aboard and holds a round handgrip with both hands. Whir! Even when the train sets off smoothly, he stays steady. His tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. I held on all by myself!

Outside the windows, everything is dark. The subway is traveling through a long underground tunnel. Only wall lights rush past. How does it move in the dark? Bright headlights light the way, and electricity from the wires above powers the train. Kongi's eyes grow round. The tunnel looks like the inside of a long rice roll!

They reach their station. The driver opens the door of the cab at the front. The subway follows its route to carry people safely. I watch when it starts and stops from up here. Hori gives a polite bow. Wow! You're wonderful!

They climb the stairs back into the bright outdoors. Hori holds Mom's hand and chats. The map helps us find our route, the platform doors protect us, and electricity moves the train through tunnels! The subway carries us underground. Beneath their feet, a rumble sounds again. Whir, whir! Traveling beneath the ground!
